exclusions.name: other hospitals or blood centres
exclusions.why_safe: The question only concerns St. Vincent regional hospital's received units. Other entities do not affect the hospital's received quantity.

exclusions.name: Elena Cruz's actions
exclusions.why_safe: She oversees receipts but does not control collection rate or shipping schedule; her actions do not change the number of units received.

exclusions.name: weekend operations
exclusions.why_safe: The deadline is Friday noon; weekend operations after that are irrelevant.

uncertainties.meaning: Whether the mobile collection drive operates as scheduled on each day of the week, and whether the average rate of 12 units per hour holds exactly for each hour open. Also, whether any collected units are added to the centre's stock before shipments depart.

How many usable units the centre has at the time of each shipment departure (Tuesday and Thursday 4 PM), given that the drive collects during the week and the centre may also have other inflows/outflows not mentioned.

Whether the Tuesday and Thursday shipments each contain exactly 150 units, as per the cooler capacity, and whether the centre has enough stock to fill them. Also, whether the shipment includes units collected that day.
Whether the hospital uses any of its own stock between Monday 9 AM and Friday noon, and whether it receives any other shipments besides the Tuesday and Thursday ones.
Whether the 3-hour travel time is exact, and whether the Thursday shipment arrives before Friday noon (departure Thursday 4 PM, arrival ~7 PM Thursday, so yes, but need to confirm no delays).
